create_optitrack_client: create an OptiTrack client that connects to a UDP server and receives streaming sensor data
connect_optitrack: connect the OptiTrack client to a motion capture server on a specified IP and port
read_sensor_data: read sensor data from OptiTrack including time, id, position, and quaternion values
get_sensors_from_cache: get cached sensor readings from the OptiTrack client by index for multi-sensor setups
close_optitrack_connection: close the OptiTrack client connection and stop the background polling thread
